notes.title: Sim Racing Telemetry Hot Fix v1.17.1: Critical Bug Resolved
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Sim Racers![/p][p]We're thrilled to announce that we have just released the hot fix v1.17.1 for Sim Racing Telemetry on Steam! [b]This update addresses a critical issue that some of you have encountered: a bug that caused automatic file format upgrades to fail, which in turn made the application unusable[/b]. We understand how frustrating this has been, and we are truly sorry for any inconvenience this may have caused.[/p][p]Our team worked tirelessly to identify and resolve this problem as quickly as possible. We are incredibly grateful for your patience and support during this process. [b]Special thanks go to the kind users who helped us pinpoint the cause of the issue[/b] — your input has been invaluable in getting this fix out the door.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32708130/fce516238177035f6674060e2a3e89130fa0672c.png"][/img][/p][p]In addition to resolving this critical bug, version 1.17.1 also includes the following improvements:[/p][list][*][p][b]Racing Line mode for F1 25[/b]: Now activated, complete with support for reverse tracks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor Fixes for F1 25[/b]: We've addressed several small issues to ensure a smoother experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Other Minor Bug Fixes[/b]: Smaller tweaks to improve overall stability and performance.[/p][/*][/list][p]We genuinely appreciate your continued support and understanding. As always, our commitment to improving your racing experience remains our top priority.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b] Technical Insights: Understanding the Bug[/b][/p][p]For those interested in the technical details, here’s a simplified breakdown of what went wrong and how we fixed it.[/p][p]In our quest to speed up file loading and conversion, we recently introduced a new system that uses multiple threads to make the process faster. Think of it as having more hands working at once to get things done quicker. We configured our system to use all the available power of your CPU. However, on powerful CPUs with many cores, this led to too many tasks being processed simultaneously. This overloaded your computer's memory, causing crashes.[/p][p]Here's what we've done to fix it:[/p][list][*][p][b]Scaled Back Threads[/b]: We’ve adjusted the number of “hands” doing the work, allowing your computer to handle everything without running out of memory.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Error Handling[/b]: If something does go wrong during the conversion process, our system can now catch these errors and continue working. Files that failed the conversion will be retried when you next launch the application.[/p][/*][/list][p]This issue was hard to catch because we were testing on a future 64-bit version of the app (!), which can access more memory, combined with our development machines having plenty of RAM. We missed how this would affect the current 32-bit version.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
Once again, thank you for your patience and understanding. We are committed to learning from this experience and ensuring that your Sim Racing Telemetry experience is as seamless as possible.[/p][p]
Happy racing - [i]The Sim Racing Telemetry Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: SRT v1.17: F1 25, new file format and more!
notes.notes:
Hey Sim Racers,  

we're thrilled to introduce [b]Sim Racing Telemetry v1.17.0[/b]! This update brings full support for [b]F1 25[/b] right out of the box — complete with dynamic wheel camber insights and a brand-new feature that translates cryptic telemetry values like “[i]DRS 1[/i]” into clear and concise readings such as “[i]DRS On[/i]” and “[i]Terrain Tarmac[/i]”. And that’s just the start: keep your eyes peeled for our upcoming [b]Racing Line[/b] feature for F1 25.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3692310/Sim_Racing_Telemetry__F1_25/]Get the DLC now[/url]:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3692310/Sim_Racing_Telemetry__F1_25/

But there’s more under the hood! We’re rolling out a new [b]SRT file format[/b] that [i]shrinks file sizes by a third[/i] — meaning faster telemetry load times and extra space for your data. All your existing files will auto-convert on startup (so, just a brief wait and you’re good to go).

We didn’t stop there. Enjoy a slew of quality-of-life enhancements, from an intuitive guided tour mode to a refreshed game selection screen loaded with session counts, dates, convenient tooltips, sortable columns, and speedy multi-threading. Plus, dive right in with pre-recorded sessions that showcase the full power of the app — no recording required.

We’re excited for you to experience these improvements on the track, and as always, we can’t wait to hear your thoughts. Happy racing and see you in the fast lane!

notes.title: SRT v1.16 - Quality of Life
notes.notes:
We're excited to present the latest updates to Sim Racing Telemetry, designed to enhance your experience and streamline your workflow.

In this release, you will find enhancements such as our [b]revamped Recording Screen[/b], a more intuitive [b]Games List with smart ordering[/b], and improved [b]accessibility features[/b], all aimed at making your interaction with SRT smoother and more efficient.

Read through the details below to discover what is included in this update. Thank you for your continued support and feedback, and we hope you enjoy the improved functionality!

[h1]Let's start[/h1]
[list]
[*] The classic but essential: [b]optimizations and bug fixes[/b]![/*]
[*] Most views now feature a [b]Help[/b] button that points directly to the user manual, helping you discover how to use SRT to its fullest.[/*]
[*] Our Games List has gotten smarter! With a [b]smart ordering[/b] algorithm, your most recently used games will rise to the top, based on their last recorded session. No more tedious scrolling, it's all right          there at your fingertips![/*]
[*] Looking for a specific lap to [b]Compare[/b]? You can now filter the laps by Vehicle, Session Type, and User, making your selection process a breeze.[/*]
[*] When the app prompts you to configure a nickname before sharing a telemetry file, you can now do so without leaving the selected session. Keep your momentum going![/*]
[/list]

[h1]Recording Screen[/h1]
[list]
[*]Welcome to our all-new [b]Recording Screen[/b]! While it won't show real-time telemetry just yet, it's a significant upgrade. You'll find useful information about your current recording, including a live chart of the number of telemetry samples received from the game - perfect for spotting any networking hiccups.[/*]
[*] We've added an application setting to enable or disable [b]battery saver mode[/b] during recording. Available only on mobile and enabled by default, this feature lowers screen brightness while recording to help your device last longer.[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Views Customization[/h1]
[list]
[*] Introducing a new [b]Telemetry Parameters[/b] selection dialog! We've simplified how you choose and arrange your telemetry parameters, with selected ones now pinned at the top for easy access and          reorganization.[/*]
[*] Customize the [b]Lap Table[/b] view by pinning your favorite telemetry parameters at the top! This          way, you can transform that "wall of numbers" into a more manageable and useful display.[/*]
[*] Need to configure [b]Statistics[/b]? Our new workflow lets you quickly select a parameter and customize its stats; you can even search for parameters by name and pin your chosen stats at the top for quick updates.[/*]
[*] When in [b]Trial Mode[/b], locked Telemetry Parameters are now conveniently grouped in a dedicated section, so you can easily spot the available ones.[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Charts[/h1]
[list]
[*] All charts now come with options to [b]maximize, minimize, and restore[/b] them, so you can hide what you don't need and enlarge what you do![/*]
[*] In the Session Charts view, we've enhanced the [b]Lap Times[/b] and Race Positions charts! Laps with pit stops are now excluded from the lap times chart for a clearer picture of your performance.[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Sessions List[/h1]
[list]
[*] Filtering just got a boost! The Sessions List now supports [b]filtering[/b] recordings by Session Type, helping you find exactly what you need.[/*]
[*] Our Sessions List highlights the [b]best timings[/b] from the displayed sessions, making it easy to spot your top performances according to your chosen filters.[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Accessibility[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated all colors to improve accessibility, especially for those with [b]vision impairment[/b], following the WCAG 2.1 AA standard.[/*]
[*] Even when using custom palettes, labels automatically select the most visible color to ensure          clarity, adhering to the [b]WCAG 2.1[/b] [u]relative luminance[/u] directive.[/*]
[*] Formatting just got better! We now use spaces for digit grouping according to [b]BIPM standards[/b], and values are rounded for a consistent and polished look.[/*]
[/list]

Please don't hesitate to [b]share your feedback[/b] or reach out via email with any requests for new features and enhancements. [b]Your voice helps shape our future![/b]

notes.title: The User Manual is now available, and what's coming next
notes.notes:
Hello racers!

A little announcement to let you know that we published the first version of the official [b]User Manual[/b] of Sim Racing Telemetry. You can find it here: [url=https://docs.simracingtelemetry.com/manual/start]https://docs.simracingtelemetry.com/manual/start[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32708130/8dd105cb7b61ccc5168f6987c4064cd92a34219d.jpg[/img]

[h1]User Manual[/h1]
We decided to keep it short and easy to read to help you quickly navigate through all the features provided by Sim Racing Telemetry.

Some sections are missing or incomplete due to changes planned for the next update.

Detailed [i]recording[/i] instructions for supported games are still on the main website ([url=https://www.simracingtelemetry.com/]https://www.simracingtelemetry.com/[/url]), under the [i]Help[/i] menu.

[h2]Knowledge Base[/h2]
Following the creation of the User Manual, we would also like to add a [b]Knowledge Base[/b] section. Unlike the User Manual, which describes how the software works, the Knowledge Base will be a collection of small articles with tips on how to analyze telemetry data, how to create some ad-hoc configurations for specific games, helpful links and videos, etc.

[h1]Next update[/h1]
The next update of Sim Racing Telemetry will mainly focus on [i]Quality of Life[/i] features: bug fixes and a long list of minor changes that will improve the current UX of SRT. For this update, we decided to focus on improving existing features to make them easier to use, more accessible and useful.

The update will likely be released in September, right after the summer holidays.

Meanwhile, we're also working on major new features that we would like to release later this year. More on this in the near future :)

Happy racing folks!!

[h1]F1 24[/h1]
Hello sim racers! Version 1.15 of Sim Racing Telemetry is now available, and it adds support for [b]F1 24[/b]! We are really excited to make this update available early to everyone who pre-ordered the Champions Edition.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2962200/Sim_Racing_Telemetry__F1_24/]Get the DLC now[/url]:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2962200/Sim_Racing_Telemetry__F1_24/

F1 24 is supported on all versions of SRT (desktop and mobile).

You can find setup instructions for F1 24 [url=https://www.simracingtelemetry.com/games/F12024/]on our website[/url] or by pressing the [b]Help[/b] button in the Recording screen.

[h2]New telemetry parameters[/h2]
The new F1 24 protocol adds new interesting telemetry parameters, in particular:
[list]
[*] [i]front/rear plank height[/i], very useful for analyzing bottoming! They measure the height of the plank edges from the road surface.
[*] [i]suspensions roll and chassis yaw[/i], useful for analyzing car slips. Suspension roll is the angle relative to the rest position, while chassis yaw is the angle of the chassis relative to the direction of motion.
[*] exact [i]speed-trap points[/i], useful for comparing the top steed of different setups at a fixed reference position on the track.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this update. Let us know in the comments!

notes.title: v1.11 - Support for F1 22 and QoL improvements
notes.notes:
[h1]Support for F1 22 is here![/h1]

We tried our best to release support for [b]F1 22[/b] as soon as possible! You can unlock the unlimited version in the dedicated DLC page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2056900/Sim_Racing_Telemetry__F1_22/

If you notice any issue, please report them using the [i]e-mail[/i] button inside the app.

Press the [i]Help[/i] button in the recording screen for configuration instructions.

To release the integration sooner, the new [i]Racing Line[/i] feature introduced recently in v1.10 is currently not available for F1 22. But we're already working on it and it'll be available in a few weeks.

The updated version of SRT on mobile will roll-out following the approval process of the mobile digital stores. If you use SRT also on iOS or Android, this could require few extra days.

[h1]Quality of Life improvements[/h1]

Following the process to improve the daily usage of SRT, we also introduced several improvements to the existing features of Sim Racing Telemetry:
[list]
[*] Improved the Racing Line view when in Comparison Mode
[list]
[*] The other compared vehicle is drawn with an independent pin.
[*] The current Delta Time is shown on screen.
[/list]
[*] The [i]pinch-to-zoom[/i] gesture on mobile has been rewritten, and now your fingers rule!
[*] ...and this is true also for the mouse cursor on desktop.
[*] Numerical values shown in the different tabs are always properly synched, not depending anymore on the zoom-level used by the tab.
[*] Improved rendering of Delta Time charts, in particular when zoomed-out. A much better smoothing is computed now, resulting in a more precise and less noisy curve on screen.
[*] Charts draw a highlighted horizontal line at [i]Y=0[/i] when needed. This helps detecting when a telemetry parameter value changes sign.

notes.notes:
Hi!

We're excited to share an important news: we reworked the recording system of Sim Racing Telemetry, and the upcoming version — that will be available on November 3 — will be able to record data from the [i]PC Shared Memory[/i]. This will make it possible to add support for an important range of new games in the near future!

To celebrate this technical upgrade, as first game, we decided to add support to one of the most appreciated sim racing games: [b]Assetto Corsa[/b]!

The PC version of Sim Racing Telemetry will be able to record detailed telemetry data from Assetto Corsa, running on the same PC, simply pressing the "[i]Start[/i]" button in the recording screen. All the features of SRT are then available, also if racing with modded cars or tracks.

Whishlist the unlimited version of the Assetto Corsa DLC now: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1660060/Sim_Racing_Telemetry__Assetto_Corsa/

[i]About support on non-PC platforms:[/i]
[expand type=details]
The "shared memory" is a technology used only by PC games (= no consoles), and readable only by applications running on the same PC (= no network). This means that only the PC version of SRT is able to read this type of data. But if you're using SRT on other platforms (like on iOS or Android), we have another good news: we're already working on a solution. The plan is to use the PC version of SRT to forward data over the network to a remote device running SRT. We'll share more details on this when the implementation will be ready, with the next version of Sim Racing Telemetry.
[/expand]

notes.title: v1.5.0 is now available
notes.notes:
Hi!

as anticipated few days ago, now version 1.5.0 is available on all platforms! Here the new features of this release:

[list]
[*] [b]F1 2019[/b] - this release adds native support for [i]F1 2019[/i] (by Codemasters). Instructions on how to configure SRT and F1 2019 are here: [url=https://www.simracingtelemetry.com/help/F12019/]https://www.simracingtelemetry.com/help/F12019/[/url] ;
[*] [b]statistics module[/b] - this release adds the new "[i]statistics[/i]" feature: you can now compute mathematical statistics for each supported telemetry parameter. This information is essential when you work on car setups. For example you can compute the maximum speed, the average tyre temperature, etc. Supported statistics are: min, max, arithmetic mean, standard deviation, median, median absolute deviation. The statistics can be configured for individual laps or for whole sessions, with output in tabular form and (for session statistics only) graphics charts. The lap statistics supports the "[i]comparison[/i]" feature.
[*] [b]under the hood[/b] - SRT now uses a "[i]data flow[/i]" approach to automatically update the views when the underlying data change. This is an "hidden" feature and will help developing better features in the future. This is a big technical change and if you notice any bug, please report them at support@simracingtelemetry.com .
[*] [b]Early Access[/b] - we decided to preserve the current "[i]look[/i]" of SRT for the first release, so we have updated the Early Access description accordingly. Of course this is a very subjective opinion, and not everyone will agree, but we prefer to preserve the simplicity of the current interface and avoid to clutter it to mimic other more complex products ;) . But for the final release we'll add two very important features currently missing: sharing of telemetries and export of telemetries. With the sharing feature you'll have the option to send and receive copies of the telemetries to/from other users and friends; with the export feature you'll be able to export to CSV files all the data stored in a telemetry, allowing you to make your own analysis using external softwares like Excel, Matlab, etc.
[/list]

As usual, the new version is available on all the supported platforms ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/845210/Sim_Racing_Telemetry/]PC[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/845210/Sim_Racing_Telemetry/]Mac[/url], [url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/sim-racing-telemetry/id1288695792?ls=1&mt=8]iOS[/url], [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.unamedia.srt]Android[/url]).

notes.title: Sim Racing Telemetry is available for download
notes.notes:
Hi!

We are pleased to announce that [i]Sim Racing Telemetry[/i] is now available for download from Steam, for both Windows and Mac.

Sim Racing Telemetry is the essential tool for the sim racing eSports community to quickly acquire, analyze and review detailed telemetry data from sim racing games. Sim Racing Telemetry records all available telemetry data during timed laps and presents them on simple and intuitive interfaces: drivers can analyze data by looking at bare numbers, interactive charts or projected on a reconstructed track.

The currently supported games are: Project Cars 2, F1 2017, Project Cars, F1 2016. They are supported on both PC and consoles (PS4 and Xbox One). We are already working on adding support for other games.

SRT is released as Early Access because the current application UI is the port of the mobile version (SRT is available also on iOS and Android), but for desktop users we want a more professional experience with a more advanced UI. Despite this, the Early Access version allows now everyone to have access to telemetry data.

During the Early Access, new features and integrations will be added, with some exclusive coming in the next weeks. We'll also add new features to improve and simplify the interpretation of telemetry data, making them more accessible to everyone.
